title: Ingest Inquire Nudged n=26 sets and compute Jaccards @ tol=1e-8
abstract: Imports storage/noesis/nmap/scan_nudged.py and runs a read-only ingestion of Inquire’s Nudged_* sets under storage/Inquire/nmap/n26/.
